items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I went and played the band, the Jew band, see, with Willie.

ctx.x: You know, Schlegel. I never did know him.

Yeah, he played trumpet, or a Jew band. So, Goppsen, they quit the band to go with Leslie George, see. So they got me to play. It was a rock band, you know, I got to cut the mustard there. I went and played the band, the Jew band, see, with Willie. Willie was playing the Tulane band, the old college boy, see, Tulane. Went to the Rose Bowl and all that stuff, man, with Bill Bank and all, see. And they got, take a solo, Willie. And Raymond was laughing, man. Because Raymond was there for a good ear, man, Raymond.…
